ex_vivo_detail: Mouse-origin ex vivo work: DyLight 800-labelled proteins were traced by ex vivo IVIS Lumina II imaging of excised tumour and major organs from 4T1-hHER2 tumour-bearing BALB/c mice; tumour tissue and lymph nodes were excised, collagenase-dissociated and analysed by flow cytometry; serum was isolated for ALT/AST/CREA and ELISA measurement.
in_vitro_detail: Cell culture cytotoxicity (CCK-8, LDH release, Annexin V/PI flow cytometry, microscopy) in SKBR-3, N87, NCI-H1975, PC9 and 4T1-hHER2 cells; plate-based ELISA albumin binding using purified human serum albumin and murine serum albumin; protein expression in 293F cells.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Blood samples were collected at the indicated times. The levels of immunopyroptotins in mouse blood were assessed by ELISA. (D) Pharmacokinetics of ABD035-immunoGN and dAb7h8-immunoGN proteins in mice.
concentration_time_figure.note: Serum protein level plotted against time (5, 10, 30, 60, 360 and 720 min) after a single i.v. dose; normalised to the 5 min value and fitted with a one-phase decay model.

bioanalytical_method: Cell-based ELISA: serum samples applied to fixed SKBR-3 cells, detected with an anti-His mouse antibody plus HRP-conjugated anti-mouse antibody and TMB substrate.
bioanalytical_quote: The protein concentration was measured using a cell-based ELISA. Briefly, 96-well ELISA plates were seeded with 1 × 104 SKBR-3 cells for 24 h.
notes: Numeric half-lives are never printed in the body; only 'less than 5 min' (immunoGN) and 'approximately 30 min' / 'as short as 30 min' (ABD035-immunoGN and dAb7h8-immunoGN) with a stated 7-fold increase. The precise per-agent minute values in the PEPLIFE2 header are NOT supported by the body. There is an internal inconsistency about the PK strain and group size: Methods say 'four groups of five female BALB/c mice each', the Results say 'the serum of nude mice', the Discussion says 'confirmed in nude mice', and the Fig. 3D caption says 'n = 3 mice per group'. The file header carries 'PMID: ?' and PMC11088320; the PMID was supplied by the assignment. The DyLight 800 tracing figure (Fig. 4B) caption says imaging was 24 h after injection whereas the Methods say the labelled proteins were injected for 10 min.
